basic_info.description: Stunning 3 bedroom, 1.5 bath house-like top floor flat with views, a beautiful shared backyard, and 1 car garage parking in a desirably located 2 unit corner building. This impressive updated unit has a coveted floor plan with 3 bedrooms on one large level, great natural light, and in-unit laundry. Views of the Golden Gate Bridge, Marin Headlands, Grandview Park, and Sutro Tower. A skylit foyer welcomes guests. The home features a spacious living room, dining room, and big eat-in kitchen. The updated kitchen has nice cabinet and counter space as well as space for dining. There is a gorgeous remodeled full bathroom as well as a half bath. The light-filled layout is wonderful for hosting friends and family and working from home. Period details, hardwood floors, and modern upgrades. 1 car side-by-side parking and storage space in the garage. The shared backyard has a Japanese garden with mature plants. Solar panels complete this home. Low HOA dues. A block away to popular restaurants and cafes on Noriega St. and 4 blocks away to many popular restaurants and cafes on Irving St. Close to Golden Gate Park, Sunset Recreation Center, Grandview Park, Muni streetcars, and Safeway. Easy access via 19th Ave. to Stonestown Mall, Whole Foods, Trader Joes, and 280. Don't miss this special home!
